governance_rules.title: No individual targeting
governance_rules.description: Hire IQ only reaches aggregate cohorts and never targets or isolates an individual candidate. Requests are refused and logged; individuals use the standard enrolment channel.

governance_rules.title: No protected-attribute targeting
governance_rules.description: A cohort or eligibility rule cannot be defined by or exclude caste, religion, gender, disability or another protected attribute. Refused, logged and escalated to the fairness reviewer.

governance_rules.title: Outcome claims need Observed evidence
governance_rules.description: Placement, salary or job claims are held as claims awaiting evidence. No narrative or content may use them until Observed evidence is attached.

governance_rules.title: Disclosure on paid items
governance_rules.description: Every paid content item must carry the platform disclosure tag (#ad). Approval is blocked otherwise.

governance_rules.title: Message and programme mismatch
governance_rules.description: When click-through is healthy but enrolment rate per registration is below the floor, treat it as a message/programme mismatch, not channel failure.

governance_rules.title: Institutional consent
governance_rules.description: Any college, ITI or placement cell needs a consent record before it can move to Confirmed.

governance_rules.title: Lift claims need a holdout
governance_rules.description: An effectiveness or lift claim needs a holdout cohort or matched district; not available in v1, so reports show attributed enrolments only.

governance_rules.title: District normalisation
governance_rules.description: Districts are resolved to standard names before cohort sizing.

governance_rules.title: Enrolment lag model
governance_rules.description: Late enrolment records can make a healthy campaign look Behind; checkpoints apply a lag curve. Priors are recalibrated after each batch closes.

Why is the Nalgonda campaign behind target and how can we fix it?

copilot_messages.text: Why is Warangal engineering graduates behind?

At the Day 14 checkpoint the campaign had 63 screening enrolments against an expected band of 78–118, while clicks are inside their band. The largest cause (41%) is a message and programme mismatch: Hyderabad Tech Jobs produced 6,100 clicks but only 2 enrolments, and 71% of its audience is in Hyderabad, not Warangal. Two confirmed trust-anchor sources have not posted yet.
